title: Plagiarism in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence: The advent of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools is challenging the scientific community's understanding of the meaning and significance of plagiarism. A new definition of research misconduct is needed that specifically addresses the use of GenAI writing tools.
